title: Why Jing province mattered: the Longzhong plan
summary: Following Zhuge Liang's Longzhong plan in the Sanguozhi: Jing province sits where the Han, the Yangtze and the roads north, east, west and south meet. Its low road north is set against the mountain road of Yi, and the events of 219 show the same rivers working against its holder.
sources: 《三國志》：《蜀書·諸葛亮傳》隆中對；《蜀書·關羽傳》；《吳書·呂蒙傳》 (sources/jingzhou-longzhong.md)

zh.title: 荆州为何重要：隆中对
zh.summary: 据《三国志》隆中对：荆州正处在汉水、长江以及南北东西诸路交会之处。它北上的低平大道与益州的山路形成对照；219年的战事则显示，同样的江河也会反过来对付它的守者。
sources: 《三国志》：《蜀书·诸葛亮传》隆中对；《蜀书·关羽传》；《吴书·吕蒙传》（原文见 sources/jingzhou-longzhong.md）

places.name: Longzhong
places.note: Where Zhuge Liang was living when Liu Bei came to ask his advice (Longzhong near Xiangyang; a rival tradition puts it at Wolonggang in Nanyang).

zh.name: 隆中
zh.note: 刘备三顾时诸葛亮隐居之处（襄阳城西的隆中；另有南阳卧龙岗一说）。

places.name: Xiangyang
places.note: On the south bank of the Han, facing Fancheng across the river: the door between the Nanyang basin and the Jianghan plain.

zh.name: 襄阳
zh.note: 位于汉水南岸，隔江与樊城相对，是南阳盆地与江汉平原之间的门户。

places.name: Fancheng
places.note: Twin city of Xiangyang on the north bank. Cao Ren held it against Guan Yu in 219.

zh.name: 樊城
zh.note: 襄阳在汉水北岸的姊妹城。219年曹仁据守于此，抵御关羽。

places.name: Jiangling
places.note: Seat of Nan commandery on the Yangtze, where the river leaves the gorges and enters the plain. Guan Yu's base in 219.

zh.name: 江陵
zh.note: 南郡治所，位于长江出峡入平原之处。219年关羽的大本营。

places.name: Wan (Nanyang)
places.note: The great city of the Nanyang basin; from here roads lead north through the low gaps of the Funiu hills to Luoyang and the central plain.

zh.name: 宛
zh.note: 南阳盆地的大城；由此向北，道路穿过伏牛山东端的低口，通向洛阳与中原。

places.name: Luyang
places.note: Town on the road from Wan to Luoyang, at the foot of the hills north of the Nanyang basin.

zh.name: 鲁阳
zh.note: 宛至洛阳道路上的城邑，位于南阳盆地北侧山地的山脚。

places.name: Yique gate
places.note: The cleft of the Yi river south of Luoyang (Longmen): the last gate on the road from Wan.

zh.name: 伊阙
zh.note: 洛阳以南伊水穿过的山口（今龙门），宛洛道上的最后一道关口。

places.name: Luoyang
places.note: The Han capital (the Han–Wei city east of modern Luoyang).

zh.name: 洛阳
zh.note: 东汉都城（今洛阳市以东的汉魏洛阳故城）。

places.name: Chengdu
places.note: Capital of Yi province, in the middle of the 'thousand li of fertile fields'.

zh.name: 成都
zh.note: 益州治所，位于“沃野千里”之中。

places.name: Jianmen Pass
places.note: The gate on the road from Hanzhong into the Sichuan basin.

zh.name: 剑门关
zh.note: 由汉中进入四川盆地道路上的关口。

places.name: Nanzheng (Hanzhong)
places.note: Seat of Hanzhong, between the Qinling and the Daba Mountains.

zh.name: 南郑（汉中）
zh.note: 汉中郡治，夹在秦岭与大巴山之间。

places.name: Bao valley mouth
places.note: Southern end of the Baoxie road over the Qinling.

zh.name: 褒谷口
zh.note: 翻越秦岭的褒斜道南口。

places.name: Xie valley mouth
places.note: Northern end of the Baoxie road, where it comes out on the Wei plain.

zh.name: 斜谷口
zh.note: 褒斜道北口，出谷即为渭河平原。

places.name: Chang'an
places.note: The old Western Han capital, in the middle of Qinchuan (the Wei valley).

zh.name: 长安
zh.note: 西汉故都，位于秦川（渭河谷地）中央。

places.name: Baidi
places.note: The fortress at the upper entrance of the Qutang gorge, the first of the Three Gorges: the gate between Jing and Yi provinces on the river.

zh.name: 白帝城
zh.note: 瞿塘峡上口的要塞，三峡第一峡的门户，荆、益两州之间的水上关口。

places.name: Yiling
places.note: Where the Yangtze leaves the Three Gorges for the plain.

zh.name: 夷陵
zh.note: 长江出三峡、进入平原之处。

places.name: Xiakou
places.note: Where the Han (Mian) joins the Yangtze.

zh.name: 夏口
zh.note: 汉水（沔水）汇入长江之处。

places.name: Jianye
places.note: Sun Quan's capital on the lower Yangtze (later Jiankang, modern Nanjing).

zh.name: 建业
zh.note: 孙权在长江下游的都城（后称建康，今南京）。

places.name: Changsha
places.note: On the Xiang river, the road south from the Yangtze toward the Nanling and the southern sea.

zh.name: 长沙
zh.note: 位于湘水之滨，是由长江南下、越南岭通往南海的要道。

places.name: Panyu (Nanhai)
places.note: Seat of Nanhai commandery on the southern sea (modern Guangzhou).

zh.name: 番禺（南海）
zh.note: 南海郡治所，濒临南海（今广州）。

places.name: Xunyang
places.note: Where Lü Meng hid his best troops in merchant boats in 219.

zh.name: 寻阳
zh.note: 219年吕蒙在此将精兵藏于船中。

places.name: Gong'an
places.note: Fort across the Yangtze from Jiangling, held for Guan Yu by Shi Ren.

zh.name: 公安
zh.note: 与江陵隔江相对的城垒，由士仁为关羽守卫。

routes.name: Army of Jing toward Wan and Luoyang
routes.note: The plan's eastern thrust: north from Jiangling, through the Nanyang basin, over the low eastern end of the Funiu hills to Luoyang.

zh.name: 荆州之军向宛、洛
zh.note: 隆中对的东路：自江陵北上，经南阳盆地，越过伏牛山东端低矮的山地，直指洛阳。

routes.name: Army of Yi out to Qinchuan
routes.note: The plan's western thrust: from Chengdu over the Daba Mountains to Hanzhong, then over the Qinling (here by the Baoxie road) to the Wei plain.

zh.name: 益州之众出于秦川
zh.note: 隆中对的西路：自成都翻越大巴山至汉中，再越秦岭（此处以褒斜道为例）出渭河平原。

routes.name: Lü Meng in merchant boats (219)
routes.note: Upstream along the Yangtze, seizing Guan Yu's riverside watch posts before they could signal.

zh.name: 吕蒙白衣渡江（219年）
zh.note: 沿长江逆流而上，在关羽的江边屯候来得及报警之前将其尽数收缚。

zones.name: Han river flood, autumn 219
zones.note: Heavy autumn rain made the Han overflow; the seven armies under Yu Jin camped on the low ground north of Fancheng were drowned.

zh.name: 219年秋汉水泛溢
zh.note: 秋季大雨，汉水泛滥，于禁所督驻扎在樊城以北低地的七军皆被淹没。

steps.title: The Longzhong plan
steps.text:
In his advice to Liu Bei at Longzhong, Zhuge Liang sets out the map of the empire. Cao Cao in the north holds the emperor and cannot be fought head on; Sun Quan on the lower Yangtze is an ally, not a target.

Between them lie two provinces whose masters cannot hold them: Jing, around the middle Yangtze and the Han, and Yi, the Sichuan basin behind its mountains. Hold both, he says, and wait for a change in the realm.

zh.title: 隆中对
zh.text:
诸葛亮在隆中为刘备勾画天下形势：曹操据有北方，挟天子而令诸侯，不可与之争锋；孙权据有江东，可以为援而不可图。

夹在两者之间的是两个其主不能守的州：中游长江与汉水一带的荆州，以及群山环抱的四川盆地益州。他说，跨有荆、益，保其岩阻，静待天下有变。

steps.title: North: behind the Han and the Mian
steps.text:
'Jing province holds the Han and the Mian to the north.' The Han river (the Mian in its upper course) comes out of the mountains east of Hanzhong and crosses the plain past Xiangyang to the Yangtze at Xiakou.

Xiangyang sits on the south bank with Fancheng opposite. North of the river the land opens into the Nanyang basin and the roads to the central plain; south of it lies the Jianghan plain. Whoever holds the crossing holds the door.

zh.title: 北据汉、沔
zh.text:
“荆州北据汉、沔。”汉水（上游称沔水）出汉中以东的山地，流经襄阳，穿过平原，在夏口汇入长江。

襄阳在南岸，樊城隔江相对。江北地势展开为南阳盆地，通向中原；江南则是江汉平原。谁握有这个渡口，谁就把守着这扇门。

steps.title: East: down the river to Wu
steps.text:
'To the east it joins Wu and Kuaiji.' Below Jiangling the Yangtze is one broad waterway down to Sun Quan's country. Boats from Jiangling run downstream with the current to Xiakou, Xunyang and Jianye.

The same river runs both ways: Jing lies upstream of Wu, so an army there threatens Wu's whole river line, and Wu's fleets can come up it just as easily.

zh.title: 东连吴会
zh.text:
“东连吴、会。”江陵以下，长江是一条通往孙权地盘的宽阔水道。船只自江陵顺流而下，可达夏口、寻阳和建业。

这条江是双向的：荆州居于吴的上游，驻在这里的军队威胁着吴的整条江防；而吴的水军同样可以溯江而上。

steps.title: West: through the gorges to Ba and Shu
steps.text:
'To the west it reaches Ba and Shu.' Upstream of Yiling the Yangtze cuts through the Wu Mountains in the Three Gorges. The cross-section of the Qutang gorge below Baidi shows the river at the bottom of a deep slot, with walls rising steeply on both sides.

This is the river door between Jing and Yi: narrow, easy to bar at Baidi, but the one way an army and its boats can pass between the two provinces without crossing the mountains.

zh.title: 西通巴、蜀
zh.text:
“西通巴、蜀。”夷陵以上，长江在三峡中切穿巫山。白帝城下瞿塘峡的横剖面显示，江水位于一道深槽的底部，两岸崖壁陡然升起。

这是荆、益之间的水上门户：狭窄，在白帝一处即可封锁，却是大军和船队不翻山越岭往来两州的唯一通道。

steps.title: South: to the southern sea
steps.text:
'Its profits reach all the way to the southern sea.' South of the Yangtze the Xiang river leads up past Changsha toward the Nanling; beyond them, the rivers run down to Panyu on the sea.

So Jing faces four ways at once: north to the central plain, east to Wu, west to Shu and south to the sea. That is why Zhuge Liang calls it 'a land for using arms'.

zh.title: 利尽南海
zh.text:
“利尽南海。”长江以南，湘水经长沙溯流而上，通向南岭；越过南岭，诸水南流直至濒海的番禺。

于是荆州四面皆通：北向中原，东接吴，西连蜀，南抵海。所以诸葛亮称之为“用武之国”。

steps.title: Two armies north
steps.text:
When the realm changes, 'a senior general leads the army of Jing toward Wan and Luoyang, while the general himself leads the host of Yi out to Qinchuan'.

The comparison shows why the two thrusts are so unequal. The army of Jing walks up the Han, across the open Nanyang basin and over the low eastern end of the Funiu hills. The army of Yi must climb out of the Sichuan basin, cross the Daba Mountains to Hanzhong, then the Qinling, before it reaches the Wei plain.

analysis.label: Army of Jing vs army of Yi

zh.label: 荆州之军 vs 益州之众

zh.title: 两路北伐
zh.text:
天下有变，“则命一上将将荆州之军以向宛、洛，将军身率益州之众出于秦川”。

路线对比说明了两路为何如此不对等。荆州之军沿汉水北上，穿过开阔的南阳盆地，越过伏牛山东端的低山；益州之众则要爬出四川盆地，翻越大巴山到汉中，再越秦岭，才能到达渭河平原。

steps.title: 219: the flood at Fancheng
steps.text:
In 219 Guan Yu, holding Jing for Liu Bei, struck north and besieged Cao Ren at Fancheng. Cao Cao sent Yu Jin to relieve him. That autumn heavy rain made the Han overflow, and the seven armies under Yu Jin were drowned. Yu Jin surrendered; Pang De was beheaded.

The Han that shielded Jing to the north here became a weapon against the army camped on its northern flood plain.

zh.title: 219年：水淹七军
zh.text:
219年，为刘备镇守荆州的关羽挥师北上，围曹仁于樊城。曹操遣于禁救援。是年秋，大霖雨，汉水泛溢，于禁所督七军皆没。于禁投降，庞德被斩。

为荆州屏障北方的汉水，在这里成了对付驻扎在北岸泛滥平原上的敌军的武器。

steps.title: 219: Jiangling taken from behind
steps.text:
While Guan Yu's army was at Fancheng, Lü Meng came up the Yangtze from Xunyang with his best troops hidden in boats, the oarsmen dressed as merchants, travelling day and night. He seized Guan Yu's riverside watch posts before they could raise the alarm. Shi Ren at Gong'an and Mi Fang at Jiangling surrendered.

The river that 'joins Wu' carried Wu's army to Guan Yu's base. With Jiangling gone, his army dispersed, and the plan of holding both Jing and Yi was over.

zh.title: 219年：白衣渡江
zh.text:
关羽大军在樊城之际，吕蒙自寻阳沿长江而上，把精兵藏在船中，让摇橹的人穿上白衣、扮作商贾，昼夜兼行，在关羽的江边屯候来得及报警之前将其尽数收缚。公安的士仁、江陵的麋芳相继投降。

“东连吴会”的这条江，把吴军送到了关羽的后方。江陵一失，关羽军遂散，跨有荆、益的构想也随之破灭。
